newsitem.title: USA: StorageTek in Kredietbank open systems deal.
newsitem.headline: StorageTek in Kredietbank open systems deal.

text.p: Storage Technology Corp said Tuesday that Kredietbank of Belgium had purchased the StorageTek OPENstorage Disk Subsystem for its 745 branch banking offices throughout Belgium.
The deal is valued at $10 million.

A spokesman said the contract is significant because while open systems disk drive products represent only a fraction of the company's overall business, it is an area in which StorageTek is placing increasing emphasis.
Open systems disk drives offer rapid storage and retrieval on UNIX-based computer systems and personal computers.
The open systems drive market is dominated by EMC Corp and International Business Machines Corp.
StorageTek's is the dominant supplier of tape automation systems used to back-up corporate information systems, where rapid information access is not the driving factor.
StorageTek said that nearly 200 of its open disk systems have been installed to date and that the entire order is scheduled to be completed by the third quarter of 1997.

"With the OPENstorage Disk, we believe we are providing the bank with a technology platform for the next 10 years and an edge over other banks, a very great competitive advantage," said Kredietbank director Carl Tilkin-Franssens of the deal.
Kredietbank is Belgium's second largest bank.
This is the largest single sale in the 10-plus year history of StorageTek's Belgian unit, the company said.
